name: Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Chicken and Potatoes

components.name: Lemon Pepper Chicken
steps: Season chicken thighs with lemon juice, zest, oil, rosemary, garlic powder, black pepper and salt; rest covered for 20 minutes.
Cook chicken in batches for about 16-22 minutes per batch until the thickest pieces reach 74 C. Re-crisp potatoes at the end if space allows.
Freeze chicken if needed; potato texture is best when reheated hot in the air fryer.

components.name: Air-Fried Potatoes
steps: Quarter potatoes into similar-sized pieces; toss in the measured potato oil, salt and pepper.
Preheat air fryer to 190 C. Cook potatoes first for 15-20 minutes, shaking periodically, then transfer to a covered heat-safe dish.

components.name: Broccoli
steps: Blanch broccoli until tender but still bright, cool it rapidly and portion chicken, potatoes and broccoli into four meals.

Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
